analysis:
This batch is documentation only: six new changelog.d entries and a memory-formula addition in docs/architecture/hardware-support.md (head 248-254, systemAvailable = max(free+inactive, free-speculative+external+purgeable)). No source code was supplied, so the claims are unverified contracts, not proof of safety.

Main item for integration: changelog.d/glm-startup-single-verification.md:3-4 (T-012, T-027, A-004, T-041 weightHash binding).
- In coordinator mode, GLM now registers a cached 'last fully verified' hash from ~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json when each file's dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime is unchanged, instead of rehashing.
- That record is operator-owned, so ADV-001 can edit it.
- The changelog says the managed load still SHA-256-verifies every manifest file before serving, and that a changed file identity during load fails the load. If true, substituted weights are still refused before serving, and the registered hash is only early advertisement.
- Integration must verify the source for three things: the load-time per-file check is unconditional and is not skipped when the stat record matches; the hash published to the coordinator and used for the SSD cache weightHash binding comes from that load-time verification; and no routing or serving happens on the cached hash before the load verification completes.

Other entries:
- Page-cache availability (a2215750 lines 3-5; hardware-support.md 248-254) loosens memory admission. This is an availability/overcommit concern, not a confidentiality one. Integration should confirm the post-load KV headroom guards still apply.
- Native-engine refusals (3c5cf8a1 line 4) now refuse up front with 400 before any reservation instead of returning 500. This reduces a consumer-triggerable fleet cooldown DoS (ADV-002).
- GLM logprobs, JSON mode, forced tool choice, strict tools, returned-reasoning rendering and VFR video (dfaad60f, 83ad8bed, 6a6db302) are new request surfaces. Output is described as withheld until validated, with a 422 and no content on failure. Integration should check that a 422 does not leak partial content, and how a 422 failure is counted (the logprob/MiMo note says engine 500s count as provider sickness).
- Video parsing changes touch TB-007 media handling. T-050 temp-file handling is not evidenced as changed.

No concrete regression is visible in the supplied evidence.
